observations: Final Chromium candidate 08 and unchanged Firefox candidate 07 each pass the expanded 34-check/13-complete-image list suite, including parser-time focus with no other control, single/multiple native key/pointer selection, cancelled input, disabled row/control, original model mutations, script selection without synthetic events, appearance release/rebind, outside release and change-callback retirement.

Chromium candidate 07 passes the prior list scope but fails the stronger script-selection image check: original selectedness changes while the suppressed option paint leaves owner pixels stale. The final original selected-state boundary supplies owner invalidation. The failed test remains preserved separately.

Candidate 07 also passes forms/radios, then fails popup disabled opacity because a broad UA selector loses to the existing feature-specific rule. Candidate 08 retains the specific popup selector and appends list corrections; the full final regressions are recorded separately.

Actual ordinary NSMatrix outside release retains an old cell visual state even after selectedCells clears it. The ordinary window and browser whole images match; the adapter invents no selection/drawing workaround. A native correction belongs once in the underlying UI library.

Initial text-painter-only candidates retain stock Blink rendering; common theme dispatch plus the verified appearance enum establishes native ownership. Earlier assumptions and their failed images remain diagnostic evidence.
